<img src="logo.png" width="100" style="position:absolute; top:10px; right:10px;" />

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(reactable)
summary <- read.csv(params$summary, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

# Overview

This report summarises **`r nrow(summary)`** samples.

# Per-sample summary

```{r table}
reactable(summary, searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
```

# Total counts per sample

```{r barplot, fig.height = 4}
par(mar = c(5, 8, 1, 1))
barplot(summary$total_counts, names.arg = summary$sample, horiz = TRUE, las = 1,
        col = "#2c7fb8", border = NA, xlab = "Total counts")
```
